# bitwrench-a2ui

> A2UI v1.0 renderer for plain JavaScript, built on bitwrench and Google's @a2ui/web_core. One script tag (global `bwA2UI`) or `npm install bitwrench-a2ui`. Renders the basic catalog (18 components, 14 functions) and custom catalogs to live DOM, or to HTML strings in Node.

Key API:

- `createRenderer({ mount, send, theme, catalogs, validation, onDiagnostic })` returns a renderer with `receive(messageOrArray)`, `receiveStream(readableStream)`, `capabilities()`, `metadata()`, `setTheme()`, `setThemeMode('light'|'dark')`, `destroy()`.
- `send(message, metadata)` is called with every renderer-to-agent message (`action`, `error`, `callAgentFunction`, `rendererFunctionResponse`).
- `renderToHTML(messages, opts)` from `bitwrench-a2ui/static` returns `{ html, css, errors }`.
- Transports: `connectSSE`, `connectWebSocket`, `parseJsonl`, `readJsonl`, plus A2A and AG-UI helpers.
- Custom components: `component({ render(p, ctx), update?(el, p, ctx) })` returning bitwrench TACO objects `{t, a, c, o}`; register with `buildCatalog(catalogJson, { Name: impl })`.
